## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall and remarkably handsome boy with curly brown hair. He has roguish hazel eyes that can express a half-shy, half-eager look, and his mouth is often twisted into a teasing smile.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P32](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0032)_

## Personality

Gilbert is a clever and good-natured young man who approaches his academic rivalry with graciousness, even warmly congratulating others in defeat. Driven by a determination to make the most of life and contribute his best, he aims to earn his own way through college.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)_

## History

After spending three years in Alberta with his sick father and a summer visiting cousins in [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), Gilbert Blythe returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and attended school, where he accidentally sparked a long-running feud with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) by calling her "Carrots." Despite his efforts to apologize, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refused his friendship and engaged in a fierce academic rivalry with him throughout their school years and subsequent studies at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), where Gilbert ultimately won the medal while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) won the Avery scholarship. Upon learning that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) planned to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Gilbert selflessly gave up his position as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolteacher so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could take the job. Touch by his gesture, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finally forgave him, bringing their long rivalry to an end and establishing a close friendship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Quotes

> "It wasn’t particularly good of me at all, Anne. I was pleased to be able to do you some small service. Are we going to be friends after this? Have you really forgiven me my old fault?"
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)

> "We were born to be good friends, Anne. You’ve thwarted destiny enough. I know we can help each other in many ways. You are going to keep up your studies, aren’t you? So am I. Come, I’m going to walk home with you."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)

> “I’m awfully sorry I made fun of your hair, Anne,” he whispered contritely. “Honest I am. Don’t be mad for keeps, now.”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049)

> "I’ll never ask you to be friends again, Anne Shirley. And I don’t care either!"
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P34](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0034)

> "It was my fault Mr. Phillips. I teased her."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert's connection with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins on a sour note when he pulls her hair and calls her 'Carrots' in class, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head and refuse his initial attempt to apologize. Though they become intense academic rivals at school, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) steadfastly ignores him, keeping her grudge alive even after Gilbert rescues her from a bridge pile when her boat sinks during a play re-enactment. Despite rejecting his repeated overtures for peace and friendship, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds herself secretly missing his attention as their fierce scholarly competition continues.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), +28 more_
